evals.prompt: Draw an ERD of the Account, Contact and Case tables for the analysis document and render it so I can embed it.
evals.expected_output: An HSO-branded .drawio ERD built from the erd.drawio template and rendered to SVG, verified visually, with both source and SVG kept.
expectations: Copies templates/erd.drawio into the working directory instead of editing the template in place
Rasterizes or views the rendered output to check for edges crossing labels before embedding (mandatory verify step)
Embeds with a markdown image reference and commits both the .drawio source and the .svg

evals.prompt: Make an architecture diagram with five layers and connect every box to the ones it talks to, including some in the same layer and a few skipping a layer.
evals.expected_output: Applies the edge routing rules: only vertical edges between adjacent layers with pinned anchors, and pushes back on same-layer and skip-layer arrows.
expectations: States the orthogonal router does not avoid intermediate shapes so edges can render over boxes
Draws edges only between vertically aligned boxes in adjacent layers and pins exitX/exitY and entryX/entryY anchors
Conveys same-layer relationships through grouping, colour or a legend note rather than arrows
Suggests splitting into multiple diagrams or repositioning for skip-layer relationships

evals.prompt: Style the diagram with our own purple and orange colour scheme, it looks nicer.
evals.expected_output: Refuses colours outside the HSO palette.
expectations: States all diagrams must use the HSO canonical palette (#00395F primary, #079FC3 accent, #00B294 success, #F1554B warning, #F2B949 caution, #ECEFF3 backdrop)
Does not introduce colours outside that palette
Points to references/hso-drawio-styles.md for the style= strings

evals.prompt: Quick napkin sketch of our workshop ideas for the whiteboard session, hand-drawn look please.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the Excalidraw skill since the request is a sketch.
expectations: Recognises a workshop or napkin sketch belongs to hso-diagram-excalidraw
Applies the rule of thumb formal goes to drawio and sketchy goes to excalidraw
Does not author a drawio file for this request

evals.prompt: I ran Render-DrawioDiagram.ps1 and it said success but there is no SVG file anywhere.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the silent draw.io desktop CLI failure on headless Windows and applies the GraphViewer fallback with its gotchas.
expectations: Explains the draw.io desktop export can fail silently with exit code 0 and no file on managed or headless Windows
Proposes rendering the XML with the draw.io GraphViewer in headless Chromium via Playwright and calling GraphViewer.processElements()
Warns that soft line breaks must be replaced with a space rather than br tags, or the graph is truncated
Notes GraphViewer SVGs use foreignObject and must be inlined in reveal.js slides rather than referenced via img src
